compiled_state.title: RED: write failing tests for merge-to-main-pr.sh story-branch PR base targeting
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: RED

## What
Write failing behavioral tests that assert merge-to-main-pr.sh opens story/* PRs with --base=<SESSION_BRANCH> instead of --base=main when invoked with STORY_PR_BASE env var set.

## Test file
tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh (extend existing file) or tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr-story-base.sh (new file if extension causes complexity).

## Test scenarios (RED — must FAIL before implementation):
1. test_story_pr_uses_session_branch_as_base: When STORY_PR_BASE=session-20260515 is set, gh pr create call uses --base session-20260515 (not --base main). Mock gh CLI. Verify via mock call capture.
2. test_story_pr_base_unset_defaults_to_main: When STORY_PR_BASE is unset, gh pr create still uses --base main (backward compat). Verify backward compat is preserved.
3. test_story_pr_base_empty_defaults_to_main: When STORY_PR_BASE="" (empty), defaults to main gracefully.

## File impact
- tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr-story-base.sh (new test file)
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh (read-only during RED phase — do NOT modify)

## Verification
Run: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr-story-base.sh
Expected: all 3 tests FAIL (RED) before implementation task runs.
